items.title: Raytheon Completes Third DeepStrike JR3 Flight Test for US Army Training Rocket Programme
items.summary: Raytheon, a division of RTX (NYSE:RTX), has completed the third flight test of its DeepStrike JR3 rocket system as part of the US Army’s Joint Reduced Range Rocket programme at Yuma Proving Ground in Arizona. The test evaluated several operational capabilities of the JR3 system, which is being developed to replace the Army’s existing Reduced Range Practice Rocket used in military training exercises.
